pr_title: Support for MCUBoot's single application slot mode & USB DFU
pr_body:
It is possible that USB DFU class is used by MCUBoot itself while it has enabled CONFIG_SINGLE_APPLICATIO_SLOT. In this mode only application slot is the primary slot.

This patch assumes that if the secondary slot dosn't exist this mean modules should operates on the primary slots.
I avoided to use MCUBoot configuration output in zephyr code (so `CONFIG_SINGLE_APPLICATIO_SLOT`) - which I believe is a one of zephyr design principle.

Also be aware of the bug  #28504

~~PR includes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/28519.~~

***building***
`west build -d build/single_usb -b nrf52840dk_nrf52840 ./bootloader/mcuboot/boot/zephyr/ -t menuconfig -- -DDTC_OVERLAY_FILE=./boards/nrf52840_single_slot.overlay`

set
```
CONFIG_SINGLE_APPLICATION_SLOT=y
CONFIG_BOOT_WAIT_FOR_USB_DFU=y
CONFIG_MULTITHREADING=y
CONFIG_SIZE_OPTIMIZATIONS=y
```

`west build -d build/single_usb`

***testing***
Similar as for USB DFU sample need to build for instance the hello_word sample with same DTS overlay file as MCUBoot.

`west build -d build/hellow_single -b nrf52840dk_nrf52840 ./zephyr/samples/hello_world/ -t menuconfig -- -DDTC_OVERLAY_FILE=../../../bootloader/mcuboot/boot/zephyr/boards/nrf52840_single_slot.overlay`

set
`CONFIG_BOOTLOADER_MCUBOOT=y`

`west build -d build/hellow_single`

`west sign -d build/hellow_single/ -t imgtool -- -k ./bootloader/mcuboot/root-rsa-2048.pem`

`west flash -d build/single_usb/`

`sudo dfu-util --alt 0 --download ./build/hellow_single/zephyr/zephyr.signed.bin`

issue_context.title: dfu: dfu libraries might fails to compile on redefined functions while building MCUBoot
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
flash_area_erased_val() and other functions are provide either by mcuboot and dfu/boot/mcuboot.c

**To Reproduce**
build MCUBoot with `BOOT_WAIT_FOR_USB_DFU=y`

**Expected behavior**
build succeed

**Impact**
Can't use USB DFU class in mcuboot


**Additional context**
zephyr SHA: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/commit/17c4396ed42bda13a7a5f2c2edb55528a008fe0e



**sloution**
flash_area_read_is_empty() and flash_area_erased_val() functions may be moved to the zephyr flash_area API.
see https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/28519

other duplicated function in zephyr base-code may be excluded from compilation using `#ifdef CONFIG_MCUBOOT`
comments: I consider that `flash_area_erased_val()` should be removed from MCUboot, as it was provided due to being missing in Zephyr. Now that it is available in Zephyr, the workaround in MCUboot can be removed.

> I consider that `flash_area_erased_val()` should be removed from MCUboot, as it was provided due to being missing in Zephyr. Now that it is available in Zephyr, the workaround in MCUboot can be removed.

https://github.com/JuulLabs-OSS/mcuboot/pull/808

I have been thinking about making a module in mcuboot (around bootutil_misc.c file) for rest of redefined functions, but this would be over-kill and would be non trivial to meet all of code dependency. Also will add zephyr from mcuboot dependency for application build (and dependency while building mcuboot would be circular).
@agansari Fixing this issue will allow us to have an implementation of this for lpc55s69 that uses the controller's query for erase. This should improve reliability of MCUboot on these devices.
@d3zd3z this means refactoring `is_area_readable()` function, i.e. moving part of the code to `flash_area_read_is_empty()`.
